$comment: Ported from the standalone map/niccolo-map project (Ptolemaic Donis-trapezoidal world map). Every ring is an array of [lon, lat] pairs in Ptolemaic degrees. Nothing here is in pixels, so the whole map is resolution independent. 'landmass' traces Eurafrasia with the Mediterranean cut in as a gulf, which is how Ptolemy renders it. 'seas' are drawn on top of the landmass in paper colour to carve out enclosed water. Add or edit points freely; sim/geography.ts re-projects this at module load. Deliberately ONE FLAT FILE, not chaptered like content/cities/chapterN.json — the physical world doesn't grow per chapter; new chapters just plot more cities onto this same already-full-domain backdrop (see sim/content.ts's own comment on the parallel convention for cities/routes/etc).
